title: personal-experiment-tracker-llm-mini-sheet
body:
Mini experiment tracker (personal) - quick table + notes

Columns: id | date | model | variant | q | batch | prompt (short) | eval_metric | latency_ms | tps | outcome/status | notes

Rows:
E001 | 2025-11-05 | redwood-open-7b | fp16 | n/a | 1 | summary-v1 | rougeL: 0.47 | 120 | 8.3 | done | baseline, clean prompt, keep for comparison
E012 | 2025-11-18 | redwood-open-7b | int8 | awq-8 | 1 | summary-v1 | rougeL: 0.44 | 75 | 13.2 | done | quantized speed boost; slight quality drop on long docs
E027 | 2025-12-02 | redwood-open-13b | fp16 | n/a | 1 | instruction-v2 | acc@1: 0.81 | 200 | 7.5 | in_progress | high variance on temperature=0.7
E031 | 2026-01-10 | redwood-open-13b | int8 | qat-lite | 2 | instruction-v2 | acc@1: 0.79 | 130 | 11.5 | blocked | need re-run with fixed random seed (GPU OOM occasionally)
E039 | 2026-02-05 | redwood-opt-13b | fp16 | n/a | 4 | rerank-mini | ndcg@10: 0.88 | 420 | 24.0 | done | batching helps throughput, tail latency ok
E045 | 2026-02-18 | redwood-opt-13b | int8 | awq-4 | 4 | rerank-mini | ndcg@10: 0.86 | 290 | 34.6 | done | quantized variant passes perf bar; monitor quality drift

Quick notes / heuristics observed:
- int8 (AWQ) gives ~1.6-2.0x speedup for 7b/13b on our test harness, quality drop small for summarization but larger for instruction tasks.
- Batching (2-4) increases tokens/sec significantly for reranking workloads but increases p50 latency - acceptable for async pipelines.
- QAT-lite seems promising but causing occasional OOMs on small memory instances; re-run with stable seed and larger workspace memory.
- Always keep fp16 baseline (same prompts) for nightly regression checks.

Short TODOs (personal):
- [ ] Re-run E031 with seed=42 and workspace=16GB (ticket INF-1421)
- [ ] Add automated eval job to CI that compares rouge/ndcg vs baseline nightly (script sketch in GH PR 314)
- [ ] Export summary table to Confluence (weekly)
- [ ] Try AWQ-4 on redwood-open-7b for dialogue prompts (E050)

Scratchpad (notes to self):
- Prompt variants tested: summary-v1 = "TL;DR: {text}" vs summary-v2 = instructive template. Put short prompts in prompt_lib.md
- Remember to log GPU type + driver + CUDA for each run (helps explain perf variance)
- For personal tracking, keep experiments < 50 rows in this sheet; move bigger sweep data into /shared_drives/engineering/applied-ml/benchmarks when mature.

Recent changes log:
- 2026-02-18: added E045 (quantized rerank 4-batch), note about quality monitoring
- 2026-01-10: started instruction-v2 experiments on 13b

Links referenced: GH PR 314 (script + runner), JIRA INF-1421 (OOM on QAT-lite), Confluence page for prod benchmarks.
